emergence.summary: A single-gene CBS loss-of-function. CBS encodes cystathionine-beta-synthase, the pyridoxal-5'-phosphate (vitamin-B6)-dependent enzyme that commits homocysteine to the TRANSSULFURATION pathway by condensing it with serine to form cystathionine (en route to cysteine). CBS LOF lowers transsulfuration throughput, so HOMOCYSTEINE ACCUMULATES (and methionine rises) -> classical homocystinuria: ectopia lentis (downward lens dislocation), a marfanoid skeletal habitus, osteoporosis, thromboembolism (the major cause of morbidity/mortality) and variable intellectual disability. The transsulfuration axis is driven DOWN, with the toxic substrate homocysteine accumulating upstream of the block. This OPENS A NEW SULFUR-AMINO-ACID (methionine-homocysteine transsulfuration) metabolic axis for the kit -- the contrast to phenylketonuria's AROMATIC-amino-acid axis (PAH): both are amino-acid enzyme/LOF reads with an accumulating toxic substrate, on different amino-acid pathways. The kit re-derives the approved corrective arms on the existing engine: (i) LOWER the accumulated homocysteine by an ALTERNATIVE remethylation route -- betaine (anhydrous betaine), a methyl donor that drives the betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase (BHMT) reaction to remethylate homocysteine back to methionine, reducing the toxic homocysteine pool (the approved lead); (ii) supply the CBS COFACTOR -- pyridoxine (vitamin B6) -- which restores residual CBS activity in the substantial B6-RESPONSIVE subset (the cofactor-restore arm, analogous to BH4/sapropterin in PKU); plus a methionine-restricted diet (lower the upstream substrate) and folate/B12 to support remethylation. The gamma read is of the CBS locus switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesions are coding/missense (notably the B6-responsive p.Ile278Thr and the B6-non-responsive p.Gly307Ser), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: transsulfuration throughput / homocysteine handling (cystathionine-beta-synthase commitment of homocysteine to cysteine synthesis; LOF -> transsulfuration down, homocysteine + methionine accumulate) -- a sulfur-amino-acid metabolic axis

per_gene.note: CBS encodes cystathionine-beta-synthase, the B6 (pyridoxal-5'-phosphate)-dependent enzyme that condenses homocysteine with serine to cystathionine -- the committed first step of transsulfuration (homocysteine -> cysteine). LOF lowers transsulfuration throughput -> homocysteine accumulates (and methionine rises) -> classical homocystinuria. As a deficient ENZYME the pathway throughput goes DOWN with upstream substrate (homocysteine) accumulation, so the corrective levers LOWER the accumulated metabolite and/or RESTORE residual enzyme via cofactor. Autosomal recessive, 21q22.3 (OMIM 613381). NCBI official symbol CBS. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; the coding/missense lesions (e.g. the B6-responsive p.Ile278Thr, the B6-non-responsive p.Gly307Ser) are outside the promoter firewall.

falsifiers.claim: CBS LOF lowers transsulfuration throughput (homocysteine + methionine accumulate)
falsifiers.falsifier: a CBS LOF allele that LOWERED plasma homocysteine / RAISED cystathionine output would refute the throughput-down + substrate-accumulation direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: plasma total homocysteine, methionine and cystathionine in CBS-deficient patients vs controls

falsifiers.claim: lowering homocysteine (betaine remethylation; B6 cofactor restore) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if betaine or pyridoxine RAISED plasma homocysteine or worsened the thromboembolic/ocular outcomes, the restrain/correct lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: plasma total homocysteine response and thromboembolic-event / lens-stability outcomes on betaine and on pyridoxine in homocystinuria
